questions.question: Summarize the discussion about the effect of training on different languages
questions.reference_answer: Using multiple languages led to more diversity which potentially hindered the model performance. The professor was skeptical about discussing the results since they had not received any good ones so far.

oracle.answer: The discussion revolves around the effects of training neural networks on different languages. The participants noted that training on multiple languages (e.g., English, French, Spanish) versus fewer languages impacts performance. Specifically, removing English from the training set did not significantly harm performance, suggesting that diversity in the training set might be more important than the specific inclusion of English. However, the team observed that performance varied depending on the types of speech features used. They also discussed the idea that the effect might be more related to the type of speech rather than the language itself. Additionally, they mentioned that previous experiments where training was done on one language and testing on another yielded mixed results, indicating that the impact of language diversity on training outcomes is complex and requires further investigation. The conversation highlighted the need to conduct more tests to understand the interaction between training and testing across different languages better.
